content.comment_body: Hello - I have a [product_name] control panel installed, and my customer reported that the clock loses several minutes every few days. Based on my understanding, the 'C' in [product_name] indicates a real time clock, and without RTC the weekly or yearly timers wouldn't function. There are a few 7-day timers in use for greenhouse equipment, so accuracy is critical. I have multiple similar setups working without clock issues. The panel runs continuously on a 24V 100W power supply from Omron. Any ideas? Would adding a battery card help, even if I don't see an obvious reason? I'm open to any suggestions to keep my customer satisfied. My last option would be to use external timers, but I'd prefer to avoid that. Thanks in advance! Also, I'm looking forward to the new [product_name] model with built-in web server and GSM features, which should be great for my panels. Does anyone know about release dates or pricing? Thanks - [user_name]

Hi. I haven't encountered your exact problem before. I do know that issues can arise if power is disrupted, and a battery can help retain settings during such times, but let's hear what other experts suggest. Don't expect the [product_name] with the new version to launch soon—maybe around September/October 2014, though sources suggest it could be later in some regions.

Hi, According to the [product_name] manual, typical RTC accuracy is +/-2 seconds a day at a constant 25°C. Adding a battery only extends backup duration from 80 hours to 2 years, but it does not affect RTC accuracy. I attended a recent trade show where the new [product_name] version was showcased, and it's scheduled for release in September 2014, with pricing expected to be below the previous generation. Hope this information is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is encountering issues with the real time clock on a [product_name] module used in a greenhouse control system, where clock drift causes reliability concerns for automation based on timers. Other forum members clarify that battery backup increases time retention after power loss but does not impact how accurate the clock is. The community also shares projected release dates and pricing for upcoming hardware models.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the RTC in the module to operate with consistent accuracy, ensuring weekly and yearly timers perform reliably without manual corrections. There is also anticipation for hardware upgrades offering enhanced connectivity features such as web server and GSM integration.
